metadata.title: Indian Plant State Availability and Seasonal Guide

availability_levels.Highly available: Commonly cultivated, widely distributed, or frequently encountered in suitable habitats.
availability_levels.Moderately available: Occurs or is cultivated in some areas of the state.
availability_levels.Less available: More localized, habitat-specific, or limited in cultivation.
availability_levels.Unknown: Insufficient verified information to assign a reliable state-level category.

season_definitions.Year-round: May be present throughout the year where climate, cultivation, and water supply permit.

important_notes: Availability means likely occurrence or cultivation, not guaranteed availability at a specific location.
Seasonality varies by species, state, altitude, rainfall, irrigation, and cultivar.
Flowering, fruiting, harvesting, and visible foliage are different seasonal events.
For cultivated crops, availability may depend on planting schedules and markets.
Unknown scientific identities must be confirmed before assigning reliable state distributions.
These estimates must be validated against botanical records before being presented as authoritative facts.

recommended_verification_sources.name: Botanical Survey of India Virtual Herbarium
National Medicinal Plants Board and FRLHT Indian Medicinal Plants Database
